priority.summary: Fermi Inc. discloses the immediate resignation of director Miles Everson, effective July 10, 2026, due to a disagreement over access to company books and records and the delegation of responsibility to the Finance Committee for overseeing financing transactions. Everson's resignation was submitted in a letter, which is attached to the filing as an exhibit, and he did not serve on any committee of the Board at the time of his resignation. Neugebauer, the co-founder and largest shareholder of Fermi Inc., has issued a statement in response to the company's decision to drop its lawsuit against him, which was filed to validate a 70% supermajority bylaw amendment. Neugebauer's claims challenging the validity of the bylaw remain alive and he will continue to pursue discovery and depositions of key players.
